description: Preview first, 30-day undo. Dismiss non-person / typed junk from the clarification queue. Reviewed and reversible: first call preview_destructive_change({ tool: "bulk_dismiss_clarifications", arguments: { entity_type?, reason? } }), which stores the exact change without applying it. After the user confirms, call bulk_dismiss_clarifications with preview_id, restore_window_acknowledged: true and request_id; the reviewed preview is applied exactly and a changed record is refused. Returns restore_id; restore_change({ restore_id }) undoes it for 30 days unless the record was edited since. The preview lists every clarification that would be dismissed; restore returns them to pending. ($0.05; API key required)

preview_id.description: preview_id returned by preview_destructive_change for this tool.

request_id.description: Required idempotency key; retries return the original receipt.

restore_window_acknowledged.description: Must be true after reviewing the preview and its 30-day restore window.
